profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior software engineer and architect tackling problems across multiple industries. What enhancement are you looking for? Whether it be pulling in data across your entire industry into dashboards, scripting just about any process you can think of, building an entire system of microservices or building a client application - you will have insights and assistance with the entire development process.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designing, architecting and developing systems that enable our warehouse integrations to client systems, robotics and PLCs.

positions.title: Self Employed
positions.description: Managing technical enhancements for businesses of all sizes

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Maintaining cloud vendor and internal stakeholder relationships for our collaboration environment.
Reviewing and supporting communications around the company for new releases while assisting in technical changes in our collaboration environment.
Assisting teams for supporting systems across the company in our environment.
Presenting project requirements and options we have to pursue to our key stakeholders in order to align on project execution across multiple teams.
Reviewing changes and updates to our company’s environment, evaluating the risks and finding ways to mitigate them. 
Maintaining greenfield development to reduce costs and alleviate pain points in our company.
Providing organizational updates and training to other teams worldwide.

positions.title: Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
IgnITe Rotation Program-
Leading a global team to migrate systems in an effort to keep our systems secure and compliant.
Leading a cross-functional team to increase visibility across our manufacturing sector. 
Evangelizing, training, and administering a system called Splunk throughout our manufacturing and business applications organizations for improved system supportability and visibility.
Containing our intellectual property data by setting up new gateway processes for individuals working with technologies we’ve recently brought in.
Presenting project updates to various stakeholders including individual contributors, managers and directors on multiple projects.
Leading the IT Services New Employee Initiative’s Social committee, a part of a larger company organization geared towards diversity and inclusion at TI. 
Supporting multiple cross-functional teams to pave the way we engage in business online.
Engaging with various cloud vendors to evaluate their solutions for use within our company.

positions.title: Herbarium Tech
positions.description: Conducting risk and error management. Systematically resolving data issues in our grant project before we exposed for other institutions to use. I leveraged my technical expertise to work my way into this position from the manual role of bar-coding or image processing.

positions.title: TAC Assistant
positions.description: Provide technical assistance for both hardware and software. This job covers any technical issues that arise in the Warrington College of Business, for students and faculty.

positions.title: Research Assistant & Student
positions.description: I have been researching in the ECE department under Dr. Huikai Xie. Since my time in research I have assisted in three different projects. The first project was to control a micro-mirror for a Fourier Transform Spectroscopy system. The second project was to find ways to implement a lidar detector onto a drone to allow for autonomous flight. The final project, which I am currently working on is to create OCT probes. I have designed the pieces of the probe via SolidWorks and we have them 3D printed. The next step is the assembly of the probes, and then to conduct experiments to test the resolution and reliability of our devices.

organizations.name: ITS NEI
organizations.description: Managing money for Texas Instruments’ ITS NEI committee. I regularly interface with leaders in ITS NEI and our sponsorship on negotiating our budget as well as evaluating our expenses and plans for the upcoming year. We have managed to transition toward remote events during this pandemic very smoothly with the impressive synergy our leadership team has provided.

organizations.name: ITS NEI
organizations.description: Organizing and managing a committee oriented towards hosting social events to allow peers across our company to connect and make meaningful relationships. Handling budgets, timelines and logistics for events in addition to delegation of tasks. Also mentoring aspiring members to organize new events and enabling them to teach future committee members.
